facts.note: Transcript states that when the temple struck ten, the kitchen clock showed a quarter past ten, and that the clock is kept fast on purpose.
Transcript states Lina came down into the kitchen at twenty-three minutes to eleven by the kitchen clock and stayed until after the temple struck eleven.
Transcript states the piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock. The music's identity is extra but excluded from the added list.
Transcript states the hall clock struck eleven when the kitchen clock showed three minutes past eleven.
